findings.subject: apps/docs (docs coverage and Markdown twins)
findings.summary: The Markdown twins that agents read (`atom63 docs`, system.atom63.io/*.md) drop code lines inside fenced blocks: 111 lines across 16 of 31 pages, including import lines and whole JSX samples.
findings.evidence: apps/docs/src/lib/mdx-to-markdown.ts:77-100 skips lines starting with import/export/</{/* without tracking ``` fences. `pnpm -s atom63 docs pattern-widgets` lines 70-72 print an empty ```tsx block where pattern-widgets.mdx:155-162 has the WidgetGrid sample; `curl https://system.atom63.io/patterns/pattern-widgets.md` lines 70-71 match. pattern-agent.mdx:146,239,265-267 import lines are gone from the twin; pattern-inform twin starts with stray demo code and loses `export const registry = defineInformRegistry([` (mdx:77). Per-page loss: pattern-widgets 22, pattern-layout 18, pattern-local-layout 14, foundation-effects 9, pattern-inform 8, foundation-surface-model 7. No mdx-to-markdown test exists.
findings.fix: Track fence state in mdxToMarkdown and pass fenced lines through verbatim; strip only top-level MDX imports, exports and JSX. Add apps/docs/src/lib/mdx-to-markdown.test.ts with a fenced import, export and JSX sample; regenerate the agent index.

verified.reason: Reproduced. In apps/docs/src/lib/mdx-to-markdown.ts the loop drops any line whose trimmed text starts with `import`, `export`, `<` or `{/*`, and it never tracks ``` fences. pattern-widgets.mdx:155-162 holds a full WidgetGrid sample (an import line plus JSX). `pnpm -s atom63 docs pattern-widgets` prints that block as an empty ```tsx fence. Only mdx-to-markdown.ts and vite-plugins/llms-txt.ts reference mdxToMarkdown, so no test covers it. The twin is what agents read, and losing the code samples breaks U1 for the docs subject. I did not recount the per-page line totals.

findings.subject: packages/cli (atom63 CLI and MCP)
findings.summary: The iOS API is not findable through the CLI or MCP: 68 of 101 public Atom* Swift types are absent from the agent index, including the ones Round 13a found iOS builders missed.
findings.evidence: grep of `public (struct|enum|class|protocol) Atom*` in packages/ui-ios gives 101 names; 68 appear nowhere in packages/cli/generated/agent-index.json (AtomAppBar, AtomAppBarStyle, AtomDensity, AtomMessageDeliveryState, AtomListRow, AtomIconButton, AtomInformArbiter, ...). `pnpm -s atom63 search AtomAppBar`, `AtomMessage`, `atomDensity` -> 'No results'. case-studies-round-13a.md:41-45: iOS builders 'read the ui-ios README and the MCP' and adoption of compact density and AtomAppBar was 1 of 7 until the README (not the index) was fixed in #283.
findings.fix: Index ui-ios public API (type names, doc comments, and the README sections) into agent-index.json and make `atom63 search`/`component` return them; add a coverage assertion to check:agent-index that every public Atom* type is indexed.

verified.reason: Reproduced. packages/ui-ios declares 101 unique public Atom* struct/enum/class/protocol names, and 68 of them never appear in packages/cli/generated/agent-index.json. The only Atom names in the index are about 30 component types, such as AtomButton, AtomMessage and AtomTokens. AtomAppBar and AtomDensity are absent, and `atom63 search AtomAppBar` and `atom63 search ios` both return 'No results'. build-index.mjs reads ui-ios only for Swift token names. The CLI README claims iOS coverage ('the shared web and iOS contract'). case-studies-round-13a.md confirms iOS builders read the README and the MCP and missed AppBar and compact density, though it blames the README framing more than the missing index entries. The gap in iOS findability is real.

findings.subject: apps/docs (docs coverage and Markdown twins)
findings.summary: Whole published entry points have no docs page and no CLI index entry: @atom63/ui-react/media, /media/lightbox, /theme controls, much of /layout, @atom63/mdx and @atom63/brand.
findings.evidence: Against packages/ui-react/api/*.api.md, values found nowhere in agent-index.json: media-lightbox 28/28, media 13/14 (VideoDialog, MediaLightbox, VideoThumbnail), theme 21/26 (AppearanceSection, SwatchTokenControl), layout 16/21 (ReaderLayout, PageSkeleton, GridChrome). Index string counts: '@atom63/mdx' 0, '@atom63/brand' 0. `atom63 search lightbox|ReaderLayout|PageSkeleton|logo` -> 'No results'. apps/docs/vite-plugins/llms-txt.ts:163 reads only index.ts, calendar and layout and claims that covers 'every component family'. check:agent-index only checks staleness (packages/cli/scripts/build-index.mjs:245-253).
findings.fix: Add docs pages (or catalog entries) for the media, lightbox, theme-controls and remaining layout exports and for @atom63/mdx and @atom63/brand; extend the index to them; add a check that every value in the published API reports is reachable from the index or explicitly marked internal.

verified.reason: Mostly reproduced. VideoDialog, MediaLightbox, VideoThumbnail, SwatchTokenControl, ReaderLayout, PageSkeleton and GridChrome each occur 0 times in agent-index.json, and AppearanceSection occurs once. The index has no '@atom63/mdx' string, and packages/mdx is a public versioned package. ui-react's package.json exports ./media and ./media/lightbox. llms-txt.ts:163 reads only index.ts, calendar/index.ts and layout/index.ts, yet its comment claims 'every component family'. The stale-index check in build-index.mjs only compares the generated file against the committed one. Two corrections: @atom63/brand is `private: true`, so it is not a published entry point and that part is wrong. ReaderLayout does appear once in pattern-layout.mdx:51, so 'no docs page' overstates that case. The media, lightbox and theme entry points are still undiscoverable to agents, so P1 stands.
